opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct publishable educational research addressing a key question in physiological education.
opportunities.summary: Supports members to develop new educational resources or conduct publishable educational research that addresses a key question in physiological education.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop new techniques, or finalize projects and promote knowledge transfer and impact.
opportunities.summary: Supports members to conduct pilot studies, develop new techniques, finalize projects, and undertake activities that promote knowledge transfer and impact.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, such as internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who require additional support to achieve their full potential.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to postdoctoral researchers to support activities that enhance their commitment to physiology and benefit the wider community.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full or Fellow members in their second year of membership or longer.
opportunities.summary: Supports members to run activities that address equity, diversity and inclusion principles within physiological sciences, in teaching or research.
